comment: Mapping only when needed; classify under appropriate rules — The draft should permit an ICD-11-native pathway and avoid equating a vocabulary match with correct classification. These are proposed implementation controls, not claims that a particular FHIR operation performs all these checks.

public.text: Mapping only when needed; classify under appropriate rules — The draft should permit an ICD-11-native pathway and avoid equating a vocabulary match with correct classification. These are proposed implementation controls, not claims that a particular FHIR operation performs all these checks.
public.suggestedRevision: Append; retain Required status: Translation shall be requested only where a different representation is needed. It shall not be a prerequisite for data already coded in the agreed standard. Results shall retain source and target releases, mapping provenance, direction, applicability conditions, and the asserted relationship, including unmatched or non-equivalent results. ICD-11 statistical derivation shall use the applicable classification and selection rules; it shall not be assumed to be equivalent to a generic concept-map lookup. Derived results shall remain linked to the original expression.
